vivian: Heads-up: support ticket — tenant sent large mixed batch with X-Embed-Dims=1024 but one item was a 9k JSON blob, ended up split to slowpath and doubled their bill.
sam: Can you paste sanitized payload?
vivian: short sample: {
  "input": ["hello", "{\"event\":\"click\",\"meta\":\"...large...\"}", "hi"]
}
kevin: We need to decide estimate behaviour: trust header, sample-scan, or async-correct. My vote async-correct: accept fast, recompute estimate in background and surface a console correction if delta>2x.
sam: agree. implementation notes: sample first 6 items or 8KB whichever smaller. respect tenant policy if they opt into strict reject. add metric embed.header_mismatch and trace tag embed.header_validated.
ops-bot: Created INF-3010 assigned to @sam for async estimate validation and console correction card.
kevin: For console UX: show an "estimate adjusted" notch on time series and send tenant email when adjusted amount > $50.
vivian: support will notify the tenant and roll out SDK guidance to set dims when serializing JSON blobs. Will coordinate with docs.
